prompt: How many countries were not listed as offering only paid access to YouTube Music at the time of its initial expansion in 2018?
answer: 16 countries. The 2018 launch covered 17 countries, and South Korea was the only one listed as offering YouTube Premium only, leaving 16 countries not listed that way.
